g.text: Anime only, Usenet only. Sonarr finds, SABnzbd downloads, Sonarr imports by rename, Jellyfin reads.
media share on Munin (one NFS export)
Anime/<Series>/Season NN/ (a rename, not a copy)
Sources: docs/services/media-automation.md, docs/services/jellyfin.md. Sonarr skips Hermod on purpose: it cannot send Apprise's payload.
